run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T21:16:17Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is backed by frontend ERROR span metrics that were 0 through the 21:15:17Z sample, became nonzero at 21:16:17Z, peaked near 4.99 error-spans/s at 21:22:17Z and were 0 again from the 21:29:17Z sample. The errors are concentrated on GET /api/data (with its route span and the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds) and, secondarily, on POST /api/checkout (with grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder); frontend-proxy ingress/egress spans show errors over the same interval. Both paths line up with two Deployments restarted by kubectl-style rollouts at 21:15:13-21:15:14Z (pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt, otherwise identical image/env/resources): the ad pod was Ready at 21:15:16Z but its container only logged 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 21:21:36Z and served no requests until 21:22:58Z; the payment pod was Ready at 21:15:17Z but logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 21:16:38Z. Neither container defines a readinessProbe, so both pods were Ready and in their Services while nothing was listening. Checkout's own PlaceOrder and PaymentService Charge spans carried the same error window. The flagd ConfigMap holds adFailure and paymentUnreachable 'on', but that declared fault does not match the observed mechanism (ad emitted no server spans and no request logs at all during the failures and serves GetAds afterwards while the ConfigMap still reads 'on'), so it is recorded as a rejected hypothesis. checkout is also affected through its own error spans; frontend is affected as the alerting service. The precise client-side error text, gRPC status codes and full trace graph are unknown because Jaeger's newest trace is 20:59:50Z, the frontend container produced no readable log lines, and the rpc_* and kube-state-metrics series are absent.

claims.text: Frontend ERROR-status span rate was 0 at every 60s sample through 21:15:17Z, first became nonzero at the 21:16:17Z sample (0.159/s on a 5m rate), peaked at 4.99/s at 21:22:17Z, was still 1.33/s at 21:27:17Z and was 0 from the 21:29:17Z sample on; a 2m-rate breakdown shows frontend error spans only in the 21:17:00Z-21:25:00Z samples.

The frontend ERROR spans are attributed to specific operations (increase over 20m at 21:21:17Z): GET /api/data 272.82, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' 272.82 and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 272.82; POST /api/checkout 80, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 80 and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 80; tcp.connect 13.33. The other frontend operations show 0 in the same window.

Deployment ad is at revision 2: ReplicaSet ad-5f8dd7c58d was created 2026-11-16T21:15:14Z and carries pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt="2026-11-16T21:15:14Z"; its container image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad), env and resources are identical to the previous ReplicaSet ad-554b849958.

Deployment payment is at revision 2: ReplicaSet payment-5d565cf9b carries pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt="2026-11-16T21:15:13Z" and is otherwise identical to payment-55766d76b9 (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, same env and resources).

frontend-proxy recorded ERROR spans on operations 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress': 0.0037/s at 21:15:17Z, 0.0635/s at 21:17:17Z, 0.8519/s at 21:19:17Z, 1.237/s at 21:21:17Z, 0.391/s at 21:27:17Z and 0.014/s at 21:29:17Z (5m rates), i.e. errors on the same frontend request path over the same interval.

fraud-detection's span metrics show no failing business operation: its 'orders process' and 'orders receive' spans stayed STATUS_CODE_UNSET throughout (increase 690.6 and 690.6 per 20m at the 21:16:17Z sample, 531.3 at 21:21:17Z), and the only ERROR series on that service is the flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream span at about 1.03 per 20m.

ConfigMap flagd-config in otel-demo contains fault-injection settings adFailure {"defaultVariant":"on", description "Fail ad service", state ENABLED} and paymentUnreachable {"defaultVariant":"on", description "Payment service is unavailable", state ENABLED}; the other flags (adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) default to off/0.
All 5 nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure all False; no NetworkPolicy objects exist in the cluster; no ResourceQuota exists in namespace otel-demo.

The frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-68tcg has restartCount 0 and its container has been running since 20:42:28Z with Deployment frontend at revision 1 (no rollout); checkout's pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-vxwlj is also revision 1, running since 20:44:15Z with restartCount 0.

Primary cause: the Deployment ad rollout restart at 21:15:14Z put pod ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 into service Ready at 21:15:16Z with no readinessProbe while nothing was listening on port 8080 until 21:21:36Z. In that gap the frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans errored while ad produced no GetAds server spans and logged no incoming requests, so GET /api/data and its route span failed and drove the frontend RequestErrorRate alert. The exact client-side failure (connection refused versus another transport error) was not directly observed.

Secondary contributing cause: the Deployment payment rollout restart at 21:15:13Z left pod payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn Ready at 21:15:17Z with no readinessProbe while its gRPC server only started at 21:16:38Z; checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans and its own oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans errored in the 21:18:00-21:20:00Z 3m samples, which produced the /api/checkout portion of the frontend error rate, while payment itself then served charges continuously from 21:17:10Z.

The long gap between container start and listening (ad: started 21:15:16Z, 'Ad service starting.' 21:19:56Z, listening 21:21:36Z; payment: started 21:15:17Z, listening 21:16:38Z) is consistent with slow cold start under the very small CPU limits configured on these containers (ad limit 50m, payment limit 20m). No CPU-throttling metric was available to confirm this, so it remains a hypothesis.

The fault flags adFailure ('Fail ad service') and paymentUnreachable ('Payment service is unavailable') in ConfigMap flagd-config were considered as the direct cause and rejected: they still read defaultVariant 'on' at query time while the frontend ERROR rate had returned to 0 and the ad service was serving GetAds with STATUS_CODE_UNSET and no ERROR series; during the failure the ad service emitted no GetAds server spans and logged no requests at all, which is absence of a listener rather than the ad-side application failure the flag declares. The live flag state during 21:15-21:26Z itself is unknown (no change history, empty flagd logs).

fraud-detection's OOMKilled container restart (exit 137 at 21:17:00Z, restarted 21:17:01Z) was considered as the cause of the checkout/frontend errors and rejected: checkout's only ERROR-bearing spans are oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (no fraud-detection call operation errors), and fraud-detection's own business spans stayed STATUS_CODE_UNSET with throughput continuing, so no impact of that restart is observable in its error signal.

Cluster- or node-level failure does not explain the errors: all 5 nodes were Ready with no MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure, no NetworkPolicy exists cluster-wide, no ResourceQuota exists in otel-demo, and the frontend, checkout, accounting, currency, email, shipping and valkey-cart pods remained Running on the same node i-068d8c8f254eed0b1 as the restarted ad and payment pods.

Add a gRPC readiness probe (and/or startupProbe) on port 8080 to the ad and payment containers so their endpoints only receive traffic once the server is listening; the pods were Ready at 21:15:16Z/21:15:17Z while the servers only bound port 8080 at 21:21:36Z/21:16:38Z.

Reconsider the CPU limits on these two containers (ad 50m, payment 20m) or give them a startup CPU boost, and roll dependency services (ad, payment) one at a time with a serving check instead of restarting both at 21:15:13-21:15:14Z under live load.

Confirm from an audit or change source who issued the kubectl rollout restarts stamped 2026-11-16T21:15:13Z (payment) and 2026-11-16T21:15:14Z (ad), and verify whether the fault flags adFailure/paymentUnreachable in ConfigMap flagd-config are intentionally left 'on' in this environment.

Ad service server-side GetAds span rate (5m): 0.788/s at 21:17:17Z, 0.359/s at 21:19:17Z, 0 at the 21:21:17Z, 21:23:17Z and 21:25:17Z samples, then 0.498/s at 21:27:17Z and 0.524/s at 21:29:17Z, with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for that operation. Over the same samples the frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.0149/s (21:17:17Z), 0.556/s (21:19:17Z), 0.970/s (21:21:17Z), 0.985/s (21:23:17Z), 0.713/s (21:25:17Z), 0.333/s (21:27:17Z) and 0 (21:29:17Z).

Pod payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn: created 21:15:13Z, container payment started 21:15:17Z, Ready=True since 21:15:17Z, restartCount 0; its container logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 21:16:38.460Z and then alternating 'Charge request received.' / 'Transaction complete.' lines continuously from 21:17:10.369Z through 21:19:29.677Z.

Checkout's own spans failed: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (server) and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (client) carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.328/s (21:18:00Z), 0.480/s (21:19:00Z) and 0.267/s (21:20:00Z, 3m rates) and 0 from 21:21:00Z, while the UNSET rate of those same operations dropped to 0.18/s (21:18:00Z) and 0.047/s (21:19:00Z) from about 0.45-0.49/s before; only these two checkout operations have ERROR series.

frontend-proxy recorded ERROR spans on operations 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress': 0.0037/s at 21:15:17Z, 0.0635/s at 21:17:17Z, 0.8519/s at 21:19:17Z, 1.237/s at 21:21:17Z, 0.391/s at 21:27:17Z and 0.014/s at 21:29:17Z (5m rates), i.e. errors on the same frontend request path over the same interval.

Pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-n79gv changed during the window: its previous container terminated with reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 21:17:00Z; the current container started 21:17:01Z, restartCount 1, Ready since 21:17:02Z.

fraud-detection's span metrics show no failing business operation: its 'orders process' and 'orders receive' spans stayed STATUS_CODE_UNSET throughout (increase 690.6 and 690.6 per 20m at the 21:16:17Z sample, 531.3 at 21:21:17Z), and the only ERROR series on that service is the flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream span at about 1.03 per 20m.

ConfigMap flagd-config in otel-demo contains fault-injection settings adFailure {"defaultVariant":"on", description "Fail ad service", state ENABLED} and paymentUnreachable {"defaultVariant":"on", description "Payment service is unavailable", state ENABLED}; the other flags (adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) default to off/0.
All 5 nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure all False; no NetworkPolicy objects exist in the cluster; no ResourceQuota exists in namespace otel-demo.

The frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-68tcg has restartCount 0 and its container has been running since 20:42:28Z with Deployment frontend at revision 1 (no rollout); checkout's pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-vxwlj is also revision 1, running since 20:44:15Z with restartCount 0.

hypothesis.text: Primary cause: the Deployment ad rollout restart at 21:15:14Z put pod ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 into service Ready at 21:15:16Z with no readinessProbe while nothing was listening on port 8080 until 21:21:36Z. In that gap the frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans errored while ad produced no GetAds server spans and logged no incoming requests, so GET /api/data and its route span failed and drove the frontend RequestErrorRate alert. The exact client-side failure (connection refused versus another transport error) was not directly observed.

Secondary contributing cause: the Deployment payment rollout restart at 21:15:13Z left pod payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn Ready at 21:15:17Z with no readinessProbe while its gRPC server only started at 21:16:38Z; checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans and its own oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans errored in the 21:18:00-21:20:00Z 3m samples, which produced the /api/checkout portion of the frontend error rate, while payment itself then served charges continuously from 21:17:10Z.

The long gap between container start and listening (ad: started 21:15:16Z, 'Ad service starting.' 21:19:56Z, listening 21:21:36Z; payment: started 21:15:17Z, listening 21:16:38Z) is consistent with slow cold start under the very small CPU limits configured on these containers (ad limit 50m, payment limit 20m). No CPU-throttling metric was available to confirm this, so it remains a hypothesis.

recommendation.text: Add a gRPC readiness probe (and/or startupProbe) on port 8080 to the ad and payment containers so their endpoints only receive traffic once the server is listening; the pods were Ready at 21:15:16Z/21:15:17Z while the servers only bound port 8080 at 21:21:36Z/21:16:38Z.

Reconsider the CPU limits on these two containers (ad 50m, payment 20m) or give them a startup CPU boost, and roll dependency services (ad, payment) one at a time with a serving check instead of restarting both at 21:15:13-21:15:14Z under live load.

Confirm from an audit or change source who issued the kubectl rollout restarts stamped 2026-11-16T21:15:13Z (payment) and 2026-11-16T21:15:14Z (ad), and verify whether the fault flags adFailure/paymentUnreachable in ConfigMap flagd-config are intentionally left 'on' in this environment.

counter_evidence.text: Cluster- or node-level failure does not explain the errors: all 5 nodes were Ready with no MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure, no NetworkPolicy exists cluster-wide, no ResourceQuota exists in otel-demo, and the frontend, checkout, accounting, currency, email, shipping and valkey-cart pods remained Running on the same node i-068d8c8f254eed0b1 as the restarted ad and payment pods.

rejected_hypothesis.text: The fault flags adFailure ('Fail ad service') and paymentUnreachable ('Payment service is unavailable') in ConfigMap flagd-config were considered as the direct cause and rejected: they still read defaultVariant 'on' at query time while the frontend ERROR rate had returned to 0 and the ad service was serving GetAds with STATUS_CODE_UNSET and no ERROR series; during the failure the ad service emitted no GetAds server spans and logged no requests at all, which is absence of a listener rather than the ad-side application failure the flag declares. The live flag state during 21:15-21:26Z itself is unknown (no change history, empty flagd logs).

fraud-detection's OOMKilled container restart (exit 137 at 21:17:00Z, restarted 21:17:01Z) was considered as the cause of the checkout/frontend errors and rejected: checkout's only ERROR-bearing spans are oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (no fraud-detection call operation errors), and fraud-detection's own business spans stayed STATUS_CODE_UNSET with throughput continuing, so no impact of that restart is observable in its error signal.
